result.text: Continuing פרק מ'. וזהו אית מחשבה סתימאה שברצון הנ"ל, ומחשבה עיונית דבינה הבאה בכלל בחינת אותיות דמחשבה ממש שנקרא לאה וכו'. And this is, we've been talking about the two types of thought. There's the thought of desire, which is subconscious, or the subconscious thought of intellect even, that's just in the nerves, and then there's the verbal thought of בינה. And so this is what it says in the זוהר, that there's אית מחשבה אית מחשבה, there's two types of thought: there's the subconscious thought of רצון, and then there's the intellectual thought, the analytical thought of בינה, which is expressed in actual letters of language, which is called לאה. And so it goes through this process of the מחשבה עיונית eventually creates the actual language where you can just think about things even if it's not intellectual anymore, which is called לאה. וכל זה יש גם ברצון שלמעלה מן השכל. So all of these, this relationship of these two types of רצון exists in every level, even in the רצון that's higher than שכל, דהיינו בחינת בינה סתימאה דאריך אנפין, שהוא בחינת מחשבה נעלמה שברצון הנעלם, כמו שיש שכל בחכמה דאריך אנפין הנעלם מכל רעיון הנעלם, והוא בחינת חכמה סתימאה דאריך אנפין, הנקרא טעם כמוס לרצון כידוע, כך יש בחינת בינה סתימאה וכו'. So this is the idea that there's the subconscious בינה of כתר, of אריך אנפין, which is this it's a מחשבה within the this subconscious רצון, and there also, just like there is the חכמה that's hidden, the subconscious חכמה which is called חכמה סתימאה, there's also בינה סתימאה. So in other words, like going back to the level of, let's say, in כתר דאצילות or in אדם קדמון, or any of these levels where even within the רצון itself there's two aspects. There's the thought that's expressed just in terms of how I want to feel, which is just an extension of the self, and then that becomes associated with something that's separate from the self, like we talked about back in the idea of עיגולים ויושר and how אדם קדמון creates those associations where the רצון becomes associated with something external, and so that happens on every single level of the סדר השתלשלות, you have these two types of מחשבה. And this goes back to this idea of the מחשבה having two aspects, being כלים and being לבושים. So the more essential type of thought is the כלי, and then the idea of the בינה aspect of מחשבה creates the part of it where it's like a לבוש, where it becomes associated with something that's that's non-essential, or like in philosophy they would call it circumstantials, where it's external things that could change. So that could be expressed in many different ways, but there's a choice for it to be expressed in one way, even though it really could have been expressed in infinite ways. And so we have that idea in the fact that God chose to make the ten ספירות, and that each of the ten ספירות should have a certain form, the fact that God chose the like within the Jewish people, there's our נשמה, and then there's our גוף. So the נשמה is essential, and then the the גוף is more external. Again, this is like you have פנימיות התורה and you have the נגלה of תורה, there's all kinds of aspects of this relationship. והוא על דרך מה שאנו רואים, and this is like we see, ההפרש בין ב' מיני מחשבות הנ"ל, between these two types of thoughts, בגילוי שהוא ברצון הבא בגילוי במוח, שיש רצון שבגידי המוח, שהוא כמחשבה סתימאה, and we and this parallels the way we see these two types of thoughts in the revealed conscious desire that's in the mind that's just expressed. So the desire is expressed just in these nerves in the brain, and we call that the subconscious thought, על שם העלם של הרצון שבמוח, because the desire when a person's, like when a person is just walking or moving or doing these kind of things, the desire is being expressed in the nerves of the body, but it's not verbal. A person isn't necessarily aware and consciously thinking like, "Lift my foot, put down my foot," or when we're breathing. There's actually this idea of the like the autonomous nervous system, that there's part of our nervous system that's just automatic, that just pumps makes the heart pump and makes the lungs breathe, and and there's different levels of being less conscious and becoming more and more conscious, so then we could like consciously move our hands and move our our feet and and consciously breathe, but even that's not necessarily verbal. We're just we choose to do it, it's not just an automatic thing. And then there's things that become more and more conscious until it becomes in actual symbols and thought. But so anyway, there's all this there's this thought before טרם שבא לחכמה ובינה וכו'. This is all before it comes to חכמה ובינה, there's just the מחשבה of רצון. And ומחשבה עיונית, and then there's the intellectual thought, the analytical thought, שהוא בחינת יש דעין דחכמה, that is when the עין of חכמה, that concept, is being expressed in some sort of tangible way where we create symbols for it and we create a structure for it, עד שבא לכלל אותיות שמחשבה ממש, until it becomes actual verbal thought. And so just as we have that process in the conscious thought, we have a similar thing in the subconscious thought, in the higher within himself, and in the סדר השתלשלות you have that same process on every level of the סדר השתלשלות, all the way back to even before the צמצום also, we'll talk a little bit more about that. Okay, so now we have a parenthesis. ולפי הנ״ל באות ל״ח, and based on what was explained previously in chapter 38, בשרש הראשון של האותיות שמחשבה בעצם הנפש ממש, about how the source of the letters of thought, even though they seem external, but they actually come from the עצם, that they're being created by choices coming from the very essence of the soul and they're really part of the essence of the soul, הרי יש שורש לאותיות שמחשבה דבינה גם כן בעצם הנפש. So this is true not only of the אותיות of רצון, that the fact that I want this, that every desire I have is expressing a specific flavor of my essence coming out, certain aspect of myself coming out, but it's also true about the אותיות of בינה, the way that I choose to frame and understand the world is also a direct choice and expression of the essence, because the the world, this kind of gets into kind of this like theory of relativity type of thing, that the world doesn't really have, let's say, a preferred reference point or preferred logical system, and therefore I can choose to interpret it or impose any sort of system on it, just like language, it doesn't matter if you name something in in English or in Hebrew or in French or in Portuguese, right, it's all it's the same thing. So, the fact that I choose to view it a certain way, and understand it in a certain way, and use a certain framework or certain model, or certain words, that is really coming from me and I'm just projecting that onto the world. And so that's a choice coming from עצם הנפש. כמו שיש, and here it says הארות, but not this הערה 5, this footnote 5 says that in other versions it says שורש, and I think that שורש is the more likely candidate here. So, just like there is the source לאותיות הרצון הבאים בגידי המוח, that just like the the source for the אותיות of רצון that are subconscious, that are in the nerves, come from the עצמות of the soul, so, too, these different symbols that we create for verbal thought also come from the essence of the soul. וכאי גוונא, רק שזה בא לבחינת גילוי דרצון וזה בא לבחינת גילוי אותיות דבינה, just that one type of letters is coming from the soul to be the revelation of desire and one is coming from the essence of the soul to be the expression for the letters of understanding of בינה, המושג בהשגת שכל, to understand an intellectual concept. So that's one idea, that both of these levels of the of the אותיות come from the essence of the soul, and in the נמשל they both come from the עצם, השם's essence, they're both directly expressing His choice. ואמנם הרי אנו רואים דמה שעולה ברצונו מחשבתו הוא אשר בא עד בחינת אותיות המחשבה דבינה, שגילוי נמשך בחינת הרצון מחשבה הנעלם במחשבה הגלויה דבינה. But there's also another relationship, that we see that a person's desire, the letters that come up and what's expressed in a person's desire in that kind of subconscious thought, that makes its way and is expressed, and influences and colors the way that the person thinks in the thought, the the letters of בינה. And so we see that like a person gives names to things based on what's important to them, so that's one aspect, that language is influenced by our desire, and so we pay attention to and create words for things, distinctions that are important to us. And also just our logic, the way we understand the world, is ultimately an expression of the desire. And so this is an idea that's expressed in the מאמר ביום השני עשר that the רבי said for י״א ניסן. And there he talks about how he brings the מדרש about how there's the king came with all his generals and dukes and everything, and it says that everybody was inviting the different officers because they hope to get some benefit from, you know, buddying getting buddy-buddy with these officers, and there was one wise person that said that he's going to invite the king himself. And it talks about the different logical reasons why it's wise to choose the king, but then he says that really it's a deeper thing than that, it's really a choice, And the fact that God chooses us and gives us a certain nature, and therefore it's because we have a godly soul, and therefore we connect to פנימיות הרצון, so therefore we would rather choose a connection that's more פנימיות of to God's essence over the חיצוניות type of connection. And so then, but then the רבי explains that that the the real essence of that connection that we have is expressed when we take that essential nature that we have, that God-given nature that that a Jew, because we have this godly soul, נישט ער קען, נישט ער וויל זיין נפרד, that we could never be separate from God, we never want to be separate from godliness. The fact that's our very essential nature, which is like the אותיות of our רצון and תענוג, that when we bring that into understanding, and we create reasons and logic to explain why it makes sense to choose this way and not that way, that is like a creative expression, and that's an expression of our choice to personalize our connection to God. And that's the idea of one of the big כללים in חסידות, that we have to take our אמונה, even though we have this essential connection, which is our essential רצון and our essential אמונה, we have to personalize that by bringing it into understanding. And that's the whole idea of bringing it into תורה and doing התבוננות, that by finding כלים to express it, even though they're more external, that is actually an expression of the essence as well, and that's a very important thing. So that's one aspect of this in our עבודה. Another aspect of this is something that he talks about in שערי אורה, that because the source of the אותיות of מחשבה and דיבור and things like that is directly in the essence of the soul, and it's therefore it's higher, even though these אותיות are used to express our desires—so if a person has מדות, so they have a תאוה for something, and then a person refines themselves, and they and they reveal their godly מדות, and now they have an excitement, התפעלות for godliness instead of for physical things, so they've made that change, but all of the memories of what they thought and what they said and what they did and all those experiences remain, and those are still connected to the essence of the soul, and so there's a separate עבודה that has to happen, which is the idea of the עבודה of the קטורת, to rectify those אותיות. And that's why, so there's a certain, you know, it's a separate type of עבודה that needs to be done, and that's something, you know, like it talks about in היום יום, the importance of, let's say, spending a certain number of hours saying אותיות of תורה or thinking אותיות of תורה, and saying things בעל פה. There's this idea that that there needs to be this kind of separate thing, and like saying a lot of תהלים and and saying משניות by heart, that this is the idea of connecting our אותיות to something. And so it's not just enough that we should want godliness, like, you know, I'm a Jew in my heart, but there's this idea that we need to express it. And that's part of the idea that we have so many מצות, that הרבה להם תורה ומצות, God gave us so many תורה ומצות, לזכות את ישראל, right, to bring us merit. And so this is the idea that we should always be thinking about godliness and always find connections and and always be plugging that in to different ways. So this is different aspects of this. Another aspect of this that relates to other places in חסידות and is especially like this last section where he says that this relationship is also true in higher levels is something that it talks about that it says כמים הפנים לפנים כן לב האדם לאדם, that it says that the fact that our עבודה causes an אתערותא דלתתא causes an אתערותא דלעילא, and that what we do brings a revelation of godliness according to what we do, מדה כנגד מדה, that comes from the fact that all the way up, all the way to the to the essence, even in the light before the צמצום, that השם's original עלית הרצון of חפץ חסד הוא, that it says that that first there was this desire that God desired kindness. And then it says that he consulted the נשמות הצדיקים and said, "Should I create the world or not?" And then based on when we said yes, we want to create it, and we consulted with him exactly how we want to create the world, based on that, then came the level of the actual plan of אנא אמלוך and the the רצון the the level of קדמון where he planned, he was משער the whole סדר השתלשלות according to that. So in other words, that the the actual desire for creation is a projection coming from us, that God is looking towards our נשמות, and and the the those אותיות which are, so in a certain way the the נשמות הצדיקים are more external, we're we're like these אותיות of מחשבה, but we're rooted really even higher than the the original רצון, and therefore in a certain way we're the source of it. And so with that, that's a whole deep concept In simple terms, it's the idea that everything in סדר השתלשלות is created for us and for our עבודה, and that's the ultimate source, even though that seemingly we're creation and we're lower, but, you know, everything is really for that. So, it's a whole a whole idea. And and this in general goes to the theme going back to like עיגולים ויושר or תיקון ותוהו and these kind of things, that in a certain way, the פנימיות is the main thing, like that there's this this כוונה, the the real purpose of the תורה, but in a certain way the main thing is the מעשה הוא העיקר and the way it's expressed externally, even though it could have come out in many different ways, but the way it actually came out, the fact that God actually chose the Jewish people and He gives us a certain body and He gives us תורה ומצוות in a certain way, with a certain history and all these things, that is expression of the essence. And we should, you know, in a certain way even deeper than the פשיטות of the אין סוף, the fact that it could have been in any way. So, and that goes also like to פורים, the idea of the גורל, and things like that. So this relates to a lot of things. Okay, last parentheses: וזהו ענין אהיה אשר אהיה. This is what it says that God told משה to tell the Jewish people, "I will be what I will be." So the first אהיה is כתר and the second one is בינה. And this is the idea דהתגלות כתר הכללי דאריך אנפין בכתר פרטי שהוא בבינה. And this is the idea that the general כתר, right, אהיה means, "I I will be," in other words, an expression of the self. So there's an expression of the self in כתר, and that's expressed in the more external expression of self, which is בינה. And this is the idea of that, again, like God's essential nature is being plugged in to the way that He chooses to create the world, and in the way He chooses the Jewish people, and in the way He chooses to give us the תורה, and all these kind of things. וכנודע מבואר במקום אחר בענין ועבד הלוי הוא, and this is explained elsewhere about this that the לוי is like serving the the כתר, דהתגלות עתיק יומין בבינה, that עתיק, which is the פנימיות הכתר, or the essence, or the יחידה, that's expressed specifically in בינה. And even though in a certain way it's expressed in חכמה, but חכמה in a certain way is more external. And this is the idea that the fact that we have אמונה or that we have a נשמה just because we're born that way, that we're just like a child to השם and therefore that's in our essential nature, in a certain way that's more external to the fact that we choose that God chooses us and we choose God. And that's expressed in trying to know God and understand Him by doing our עבודה, like we're doing here, or trying to bring it into בינה, bring our אמונה בפנימיות. וכנודע מבואר במקום אחר בענין וע- sorry, yeah, דוקא והוא ענין ג' קוצין דיו''ד, and these are the idea of the three horns of the letter י', and this is a little bit difficult to explain without a picture. But if you look at the way a י' is written in a ספר תורה, it's a lot of times in this in like a סידור or like the way it's printed in this ספר, it's really just has two horns. There's a horn up on the top left, and then there's the little horn on the bottom, the little point at the bottom right. But in a ספר תורה, it's actually written as a line. So the left, going from that top point, there's a line that goes straight down. And then there's like a little box that goes from the middle of that line to the left to the right, that's thicker. And then it comes down to another point on the bottom right. So you actually have a third point that's directly below the top the top left point. And so these represent, the top left point represents the source of חכמה in the כתר. The the the point that's directly under it represents יסוד of חכמה, which is the revelation of the כתר in the flash of חכמה, and that's the idea of like that that, you know, flash of חכמה, and the idea of אמונה and things like that. And then there's the way that it is מתפשט and goes to the right, and comes down as into בינה. And so this is the idea that the way that the כתר and the חכמה come down into understanding, even though in a certain way that's lower than the expression of חכמה, but that is actually higher. And so like the שער הנו''ן of בינה really goes up to עצם, in a way more than חכמה, and this is so this is this whole thing we're talking about here. כמו שמבואר במקום אחר באריכות, as explained elsewhere at length, ודי למבין, and that's enough to understand.
